h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Serampore

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Serampore

items.pText: In Serampore, as in much of the Hooghly belt, the local para club often runs the only open ground in a neighbourhood. That same ground hosts football, morning walks and the Durga Puja pandal in autumn. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to clubs, schools and municipal parks here, made at our factory in Vasai East, Maharashtra, about 1,640 km away.

Serampore is an old riverside town on the west bank of the Hooghly, with a Danish past and a humid climate. When a ground has many uses, the play area has to sit where it does not block the rest. Share a rough plan of the ground, with its size and the spots used for events, along with a few photos. We will suggest equipment and send a layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Placing play equipment on a shared club ground

c: Put the play area along one edge or in a corner, close to a boundary wall, so the centre of the ground stays free for football and the pandal. Grout the posts firmly, because crowds at festival time lean on and climb anything nearby. A low fence with a gate around the play area keeps balls and bicycles out.

items.q: Can a para club order playground equipment from you?
items.a: Yes. We work with clubs, schools, societies and public bodies. Share the ground size and photos and we will send a layout drawing and quote that the club committee can review.

items.q: Will the equipment be in the way during Durga Puja?
items.a: Not if it is placed well. We suggest an edge or corner of the ground so the centre stays free for the pandal, and mark this on the layout drawing.

items.q: How is the equipment sent to Serampore?
items.a: By road from our Vasai factory. Installation is done by our own team or a dealer in eastern India, grouted or self-standing depending on the ground.
